description: This file implements the onoff manager for power or resource control in Zephyr OS, including state management, event processing, client notifications, and monitor handling.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the state bits in the onoff_manager's flags.

methods.name: validate_args
methods.description: Validates the arguments for onoff client operations.

methods.name: notify_monitors
methods.description: Notifies all registered monitors of a state change.

methods.name: notify_one
methods.description: Notifies a single client of a state change.

methods.name: notify_all
methods.description: Notifies all clients in a list of a state change.

methods.name: process_event
methods.description: Handles state transition events for the onoff manager.

methods.name: transition_complete
methods.description: Handles completion of a transition and triggers re-evaluation.

methods.name: process_recheck
methods.description: Determines if a state transition is needed based on current conditions.

methods.name: process_complete
methods.description: Processes the completion of a transition, updating state and notifying clients.
